items.text: Added save transfer codes, allowing game progress to be synchronized between mobile and PC. (Console, global iOS, and Google Play versions have not yet been updated.)
Added a Clean UI option that can hide the in-game version number, promotional content, and more.
Significantly reduced the game's size and improved performance for smoother gameplay.
Improved the TV filter and added support for it on mobile.
Improved mini-game exit behavior. Quitting a mini-game now returns you to the arcade room, making it easier to choose another one.
Improved behavior on lower-end devices that cannot play videos. Videos are now skipped instead of preventing the game from starting.
Fixed an issue where virtual buttons would remain visible when switching from touch controls to a controller after restarting.
Fixed an issue where the display would not recover correctly after switching between foldable-screen and split-screen modes on mobile.
Fixed scene display issues caused by switching to the main menu at the exact moment of entering a black hole.
Fixed an issue where the CATOCA mini-game could not be restarted from the game menu.
Fixed an incorrect camera angle after restarting and respawning in the roller coaster level.
Fixed an issue where the Box Toast skin could occasionally appear tilted.
Fixed an incorrect character orientation after repeatedly switching Box Toast skins in the skin shop.
Fixed an animation issue after the cat attached to a paw platform while floating.
Fixed an issue where the cat might not be crushed by a rotating door.
Fixed an issue where Toast could skip past a toaster at low frame rates.
Fixed insufficient bounce height when the cat moved from flat ground onto the butter bounce pad in W05-L15.
Fixed an issue in W05-L14 where Toast could no longer jump after charging outside the gravity field, entering it, and attaching to a wall.
Fixed an issue in W05-L04B where the cat could get stuck on the ceiling after swapping with Toast.
Fixed an issue where Shadow Cat could lose its target or move in the wrong direction when the gravity field changed.
Fixed an issue in W05-L25 where Shadow Cat could no longer act after picking up a cloned Toast and resetting the level.
Fixed an issue where Shadow Cat's walking animation could stop working after resetting related levels.
Fixed an issue where some controllers had their A/B buttons swapped
Fixed an issue where deleted save files were automatically restored
Fixed an abnormality in the perfect score settlement in Snake Cat
Fixed an issue where resetting key configurations did not work
Fixed an issue preventing players from using the keyboard to play the game
Fixed an issue where the cat might get stuck in the connecting compartment in W05_L17 and be unable to exit
Fixed an issue where the roller coaster game could not be paused
We are currently porting the game to NS, PS5, and mobile platforms; these optimizations have also been applied to the Steam version
Reduced level load times on mid-to-low-end devices
Improved frame rates on mid-to-low-end devices
Reduced the overall game size
You can submit bugs via the bug submission button in the game's main menu or directly through the survey link: https://jsj.top/f/EMQrN3.
Fixed an issue where completing the W01 and W04 roller coaster levels for the first time would not unlock their respective achievements
Fixed a bug preventing DualSense controllers from using shoulder-button charge in W05 special force field levels
Improved level loading speed for slightly faster load times
Changed the confirmation button to A when using NS controllers
Minor French localization adjustments

releases.displayName: Major Update! Multilanguage, Keybinding feature, Community Items live now!

items.text: Hello to all players!
We have lots of new stuff in this update!
As part of our Halloween Skin Contest, the hatchet skins are ready for you! Also, with the other 4 new skins, redeem the command to unlock the full bundle of 5 skins!
Pumpkin, shark, slipper, or hat—special toasts now spin more realistically in-game.
New trading cards, badges, emoticons, and profile backgrounds are now live. Collect them all and showcase your style!

notes.title: 4. Custom Key Bindings & Remote Play Now Supported!

items.text: The customize key bindings feature is available now! Choose the default key recommendations or set them according to your preferences. Whether you're playing local co-op or using Remote Play, you can adjust the controls for a comfortable gaming experience with friends!

notes.title: CATO: Buttered Cat can now support the following languages

Traditional Chinese 繁體中文
Russian Русский
Portuguese Português (Portugal & Brazil)
Spanish Español
Ukrainian Українська

items.text: Halloween Skins Added
Ghost Kitty and Pumpkin Toast mak their grand debut! Remember to update the game before redeeming! (Redemption codes can be found in the comments and posts).
Save File Switch Function Now Available
The save file switch feature is now officially live. You can switch save files from the start menu after entering the game!

Fixed a black screen bug when failing the second trampoline in the continuous launch sequence in the latter half of the roller coaster, making the game unplayable

Fixed a bug in Flappy CATO where you could separate and score before starting the game
Fixed an issue in W02_L26 where rotating boards hit the accelerating cat
Fixed a bug in W02_L12_R3 where at low frame rates, the accelerating cat gets stuck in the lower pipe loop, causing the game to stall
Fixed an issue where the toast would hit the ceiling when jumping at the moment of touching the butter trampoline (e.g., W02_L11C)
Fixed a bug where the slow-motion effect didn't cancel after entering the toaster in the Swappy level (W01_L17E)
Fixed an issue in W01_L17E where excessive swapping with Swappy would make the toast disappear
Fixed a bug in W04_L21A where Swappy follows the player but cannot use skills
Fixed a paradox wall inversion caused by performing extreme stunts in W03_L24A
Fixed residual force field issues caused by all force field switches (W05-L17)
Fixed an eye texture issue with the W05 boss
Fixed an issue where CATO's model might disappear at the start of a level
Fixed an issue where charging the toast during the cat's death caused the controller vibration to not cancel
Fixed an issue where swapping during toast charging caused the controller vibration to not cancel
Fixed an issue where getting hit while charging the toast caused the controller vibration to not cancel
Added save points to the W05 boss
Added Mid-Autumn Festival skins
Ongoing investigation on W05 boss bugs

Hello, friends! Thank you for playing and providing feedback. The Steam version of "CATO: Buttered Cat" has now been updated to version 1.0.454. The main updates are as follows:
Fixed a critical issue that caused the game to crash during the Snake Cat mini-game. For all you mini-game masters out there, the game will now automatically end when you reach 80 points.
Resolved an issue where toast skin models overlapped in the Snake Cat mini-game.
Slightly increased the cat's speed in the Snake Cat mini-game.
Fixed a bug related to unlocking the achievement when you collected all skins: “You Rock!”

Rewards obtained in the roller coaster game will now automatically pop up.: Other reported bugs are also in the queue for urgent fixes. If you encounter any issues in the game, you can try using the reset button to reset the level.: Regarding the much-requested custom key-binding feature, we are currently working on it, and it will be implemented in a future update.
You can submit bugs via the bug submission button in the game's main menu or directly through the survey link: https://jsj.top/f/EMQrN3.
